trap.label: estrutura
trap.wrong: For all its flaws, but it works.
trap.right: For all its flaws, it works.
trap.why: Português admite “apesar de…, mas”; for all é concessão que dispensa but.

fix.wrong: For all its flaw, it works.
fix.right: For all its flaws, it works.

fix.wrong: However small is it, it counts.
fix.right: However small it is, it counts.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com for all: “Although it has flaws, it works.”
rewrite.answer: For all its flaws, it works.

rewrite.prompt: Com however: “It is small, but it counts.”
rewrite.answer: However small it is, it counts.

rewrite.prompt: Com albeit: “It is imperfect, but it works.”
